Subject: Audit logging discovery & SOC 2 follow-up

Hi Jordan — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side: 

Summary of what we covered
- Audit logging surface: admin activity logs (UI & Console), API request/response logs, model invocation logs (tokens, latency metadata), and system-level export logs.
- Exportability: logs can be exported in JSON/NDJSON or CSV to customer-owned S3 buckets or downloaded from the Console for ad-hoc review.
- Immutability options: for Private deployments we support object-lock/WORM on S3 exports; hosted customers get an append-only event store with tamper-evident checksums and export snapshots.
- Retention & access: configurable retention policies per-account; default retention for hosted accounts is 1 year, can be extended via Dedicated/Private contracts.

Attachments I attached for your review: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (status & scope) and audit-logging-export-sample.json (sample export).

Proposed next steps
1) Send over any specific items from your vendor security questionnaire — we can populate answers and attach evidence.
2) I'll loop in Neha (SE) to provide export/format samples and retention details.
3) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up with your security team next week.

Jordan — let me know which items you want prioritized and if Security wants the questionnaire started now.

Best,
Marissa

Jordan — thanks for the quick reply. Short answers below, and I've opened the vendor questionnaire in OneTrust so your team can begin populating. Link included in metadata.

SOC 2 status
- Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type I and has a Type II engagement in progress. We expect the Type II report covering core inference and control plane services to be completed in Q2 2027. I've attached a one-page summary that outlines scope and controls we've implemented (Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf).

Retention & export
- Hosted customers: default retention is 365 days; exports to customer-owned S3 buckets are supported today via the Console export job. For retention beyond 365 days we support automated export jobs to your S3 (daily/weekly) for archival.
- Dedicated/Private: fully configurable retention policies and support for S3 object-lock/WORM. For Private deployments we can also enable immutable storage guarantees on request.

Immutability & proof
- Export snapshots include SHA-256 checksums and timestamped manifests to provide tamper-evident proof of exports. For Private deployments you can enable object-lock on your S3 bucket to meet WORM requirements.

Next steps
- I started the OneTrust questionnaire (link below) and attached the vendor questionnaire template for your convenience. Neha will follow up with a sample export and a short technical note on endpoints and fields.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call with your security team if you'd like.

Best,
Marissa

Hi Jordan — looping in a few technical details that might help your questionnaire team. Short answers below and happy to provide sample exports or a quick demo of the export flow.

1) What we log
- Admin activity logs: user sign-ins, role changes, permission updates, console UI actions (who/what/when).
- API logs: request/response metadata (timestamp, endpoint, request-id, account-id, caller identity), token usage metrics (model, prompt size in tokens), and latency metrics. We do not store full user prompts for customers that opt for privacy controls (we have redaction options per account).

2) Export format & mechanism
- Export formats: JSON (NDJSON for streaming), CSV for common fields.
- Export mechanism: Console export job or API-based export to a pre-signed S3 bucket you own. Exports include a manifest.json with SHA-256 hashes. Sample export attached (audit-logging-export-sample.json).

3) Immutability & verification
- Hosted: append-only event store with signed manifests; we can provide export snapshots with checksums for tamper-evidence.
- Dedicated/Private: enable S3 Object Lock and governance mode for WORM. We can provide configuration guidance and a short runbook for S3 lifecycle + Object Lock setup.

4) Retention policy
- Default hosted retention: 365 days (configurable via support/contract for Enterprise plans).
- Dedicated/Private: retention configurable -> e.g., 400+ days supported by default with automated export.

If you share the vendor questionnaire questions for the audit-logging section, I can produce canned answers and attach sample exports.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
